title: Derived scalar Hom comparison coherence for arbitrary inputs
statement: For the recorded scalar derived models M [def-sfb-scalar-hom-comparison-data] and normalized strong scalar tensor comparisons mu [lem-sfb-scalar-hom-tensor-coherence], the evaluation-defined coefficientBaseChangeHom is natural in both arbitrary derived inputs, is compatible with composition and identity scalar extension, and is compatible with every commuting coefficient square, transported by the canonical composite extension isomorphism. All equalities concern actual derived morphisms, including inverses of localized quasi-isomorphisms. This is independent of flat chain representatives or K-injective complexes.

proof.text: Apply scalarHomTensorCoherence to the normalized tensor comparisons. The already proved scalarHomComparisonTower gives naturality, composition and identity for the evaluation-defined Hom maps on all derived objects.

For a commuting coefficient square use composition for its two paths. Substitute the equality of their composite ring maps. Conjugate the two equalities by the inverse composite extension isomorphism on the two Hom inputs and on the source. Bifunctoriality and cancellation of the resulting isomorphisms give the displayed derived square.
